content: Payment webhook idempotent processing: YooKassa/CloudPayments send at-least-once delivery with retries over 24h. Architecture: 1) Accept webhook → immediately respond 200 → process asynchronously via ARQ job. 2) Use payment ID as idempotency key — check if already processed in DB before acting. 3) Verify webhook authenticity: YooKassa recommends IP whitelisting (185.71.76.0/27, etc.), CloudPayments uses HMAC signature. 4) Handle events: payment.succeeded → grant access + calculate commission; payment.canceled → revoke; refund.succeeded → reverse. 5) Transactional flow: payment → access grant → commission calculation must be atomic. 6) Store raw webhook payload for audit trail. Key anti-pattern: doing heavy work in webhook handler before responding 200 causes timeouts and duplicate delivery.
